question: Seven friends Manu, Nikita, Om, Palak, Karim, Raj and Suraj live in the 7 floor building. The lowest floor is number 1 and the number 7 of the top floor is 7. There are three floors between Om and Karim. Manu lives on a floor just above Raj and just below Suraj. The Raj lives on an even number floor and below the 5th floor. Suraj does not live above Karim. Om, remains just below the Raj. The number of people living under Karim is equal to the number of people living above Nikita. Who lives on the second floor?
solution:
Given: Seven friends Manu, Nikita, Om, Palak, Karim, Raj and Suraj live in the 7 floor building. The lowest floor is number 1 and the number 7 of the top floor is 7.

1) The Raj lives on an even number floor and below the 5th floor.

2) Om, remains just below the Raj.

3) There are three floors between Om and Karim.
